Free online HTML to PDF converter — private by design

Turn any self-contained HTML file into a PDF without uploading it anywhere. Everything runs locally in your browser, so reports, invoices, resumes and documents stay on your device.

How to convert HTML to PDF

  1. Choose an .html or .htm file, or drag it onto the page.
  2. Click Convert to PDF.
  3. Your PDF downloads automatically.

Frequently asked questions

Is my HTML file uploaded to a server?

No. The conversion runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your file never leaves your device.

Is the HTML to PDF converter free?

Yes. It is free to use, with no signup, watermark or file-size limit imposed by the site.

How do I convert an HTML file to PDF?

Choose or drag and drop a .html or .htm file, click Convert to PDF, and the PDF downloads automatically.

Why are my images or styles missing in the PDF?

The converter works best with self-contained HTML. Inline your CSS and embed images as data URIs, because external files cannot be loaded from a local file.

Is it safe to convert HTML with scripts?

Yes. The HTML is sanitized in your browser before rendering, so scripts are removed and never executed.
